comment: Tiny Tapeout boards and libraries the labs read. fetch_boards.py checks each one out at the commit below into labs/common/upstream/<dest>. Nothing here is copied into this repo. 'paths' are git sparse-checkout patterns (non-cone): only those files are downloaded.

sources.name: breakout-pcb
sources.used_for: The SKY130 QFN breakout (rev 3.2) that Lab 01 reads; the IHP breakout's own QFN-64 footprint for Lab 02; the 2-layer DIP dock, Lab 03's closest reference.

sources.name: tinytapeout-kicad-libs
sources.used_for: The commit breakout-pcb's submodule names. It sits where the breakouts' fp-lib-table and sym-lib-table look for it (${KIPRJMOD}/../tinytapeout-kicad-libs) and where the demo board's fp-lib-table looks for it (${KIPRJMOD}/../breakout-pcb/tinytapeout-kicad-libs). breakout-pcb's .gitmodules points at psychogenic/tinytapeout-kicad-libs; the same commit is in TinyTapeout's repository, which is the one fetched here.

sources.name: tt-demo-pcb
sources.license: Apache-2.0 for the PCB, CC0 for the documentation (README)
sources.used_for: The RP2350 demo board: how it loads the project pins (DIP switches, 7-segment display), where its TVS diodes are, and the fp-info-cache it still tracks in git.

sources.name: kicad-tinytapeout-pmod-lib
sources.used_for: Tiny Tapeout's Pmod connector footprints and placement rules for Lab 03.

sources.name: pcb-files
sources.license: No licence file in the repository; fetched for reading only, never copied into this repo
sources.used_for: Tiny Tapeout's production BOM for the SKY130 QFN breakout rev 3.2 (2025-10-04), to compare with the fitted parts in Lab 01.
